# Print Today UK — In-House Same-Day Printing London

> Print Today UK is an in-house commercial and digital print studio based at 75 Green Street, London, E7 8JF. We provide rapid same-day digital printing, wide-format signage, custom apparel (DTF t-shirts and hoodies), business stationery, booklets, and promotional media with free in-person studio collection and same-day London courier delivery.

## Core Products & Capabilities
- **Business Cards**: 400gsm premium silk, matt laminated, soft-touch velvet, gloss, and spot UV finishes. Same-day available. (https://www.printtodayuk.com/product/business-cards)
- **Flyers & Leaflets**: A7, A6, A5, A4, DL on 130gsm, 170gsm, 250gsm, and 350gsm silk and gloss paper. Folded leaflets (half fold, tri fold, z-fold). (https://www.printtodayuk.com/product/flyers)
- **Roller Banners & Signage**: 800mm, 850mm, 1000mm, 1200mm, 1500mm pull-up roller banners with padded carry cases. PVC outdoor vinyl banners with brass eyelets and reinforced hems. (https://www.printtodayuk.com/product/standard-roller-banners)
- **Posters & Large Format**: Architectural CAD drawings, plan printing, photorealistic satin posters up to A0 and custom dimensions, foam board foamex signs. (https://www.printtodayuk.com/product/large-format-posters)
- **Custom Clothing & Apparel**: Industrial Direct-to-Film (DTF) full-color garment printing on 100% ring-spun cotton t-shirts, heavy-blend hoodies, sweatshirts, polo shirts, tote bags, and high-vis workwear. No minimum order quantity. (https://www.printtodayuk.com/clothing)
- **Books & Booklets**: Wiro bound presentation booklets, saddle-stitched (stapled) brochures, catalogs, order of service, event programs, and carbonless NCR duplicate pads. (https://www.printtodayuk.com/category/Books%20%26%20Booklets)
- **Documents & Presentations**: Spiral bound theses, corporate reports, handouts, flyers, laminated menus, and certificates. (https://www.printtodayuk.com/document-printing-near-me)
- **Seasonal Printing**: Calendars, desk pads, wall planners, custom wrapping paper, and branded gift tags. (https://www.printtodayuk.com/christmas-printing)

## Production & Artwork Specifications
- **Preferred File Format**: Press-ready PDF (PDF/X-1a or PDF/X-4).
- **Acceptable File Formats**: High-resolution PNG, TIFF, Adobe Illustrator (.AI), Adobe Photoshop (.PSD), SVG.
- **Resolution**: 300 DPI at 100% final output size (150 DPI acceptable for billboards and extra-large format banners).
- **Color Mode**: CMYK (FOGRA39 or Coated GRACoL recommended). RGB files are automatically converted using press color management.
- **Bleed**: 3mm bleed on all outer edges.
- **Safe Zone**: 3mm to 5mm inside cut line (keep all critical text and logos inside).
- **Preflight Check**: Complimentary preflight artwork inspection on every order before plate/digital release.
- **Artwork Guides & Templates**: https://www.printtodayuk.com/artwork-guides

## Delivery & Service Coverage
- **In-Person Collection**: 75 Green Street, London, E7 8JF (Free). Nearest stations: Upton Park (District / Hammersmith & City), Forest Gate (Elizabeth Line), Woodgrange Park (Overground).
- **Same-Day London Courier**: Dedicated motorcycle and van couriers serving Central London (EC1–EC4, WC1–WC2), East London (E1–E18), Canary Wharf (E14), Stratford (E15), South London (SE1), and all 32 London boroughs within 2–4 hours of completion.
- **UK Nationwide Delivery**: DPD and Royal Mail Tracked 24 next-day priority courier.
